racket_target.target_code:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (sr-set (make-hash))
                  (sc-set (make-hash))
                  (dummy (for ((r (range 0 hh)))
                           (when
                             (for/and ((c (range 0 ww))) (zero? (at g r c)))
                             (hash-set! sr-set r #t))))
                  (dummy2 (for ((c (range 0 ww)))
                            (when
                              (for/and ((r (range 0 hh))) (zero? (at g r c)))
                              (hash-set! sc-set c #t))))
                  (row-groups (list))
                  (col-groups (list))
                  (dummy3 (let loop
                               ((i 0))
                               (when
                                 (< i hh)
                                 (if (hash-has-key? sr-set i)
                                     (loop (+ i 1))
                                     (let inner
                                          ((j i))
                                          (if (or (>= j hh) (hash-has-key? sr-set j))
                                              (begin
                                                (set! row-groups
                                                      (append row-groups
                                                              (list (list i (- j 1)))))
                                                (loop j))
                                              (inner (+ j 1))))))))
                  (dummy4 (let loop
                               ((i 0))
                               (when
                                 (< i ww)
                                 (if (hash-has-key? sc-set i)
                                     (loop (+ i 1))
                                     (let inner
                                          ((j i))
                                          (if (or (>= j ww) (hash-has-key? sc-set j))
                                              (begin
                                                (set! col-groups
                                                      (append col-groups
                                                              (list (list i (- j 1)))))
                                                (loop j))
                                              (inner (+ j 1))))))))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (for ((rg row-groups))
               (let* ((r1 (first rg))
                      (r2 (second rg))
                      (lcg (first col-groups))
                      (rcg (second col-groups))
                      (lc1 (first lcg))
                      (lc2 (second lcg))
                      (rc1 (first rcg))
                      (rc2 (second rcg))
                      (bg-l (mode-list (for*/list ((r (range r1 (+ r2 1))) (c (range lc1 (+ lc2 1))))
                                         (at g r c))))
                      (bg-r (mode-list (for*/list ((r (range r1 (+ r2 1))) (c (range rc1 (+ rc2 1))))
                                         (at g r c)))))
                 (let ((shape-r (for*/list ((r (range r1 (+ r2 1))) (c (range rc1 (+ rc2 1)))
                                    #:when
                                    (!= (at g r c) bg-r))
                                  (list (- r r1) (- c rc1))))
                       (shape-l (for*/list ((r (range r1 (+ r2 1))) (c (range lc1 (+ lc2 1)))
                                    #:when
                                    (!= (at g r c) bg-l))
                                  (list (- r r1) (- c lc1)))))
                   (for* ((r (range r1 (+ r2 1))) (c (range lc1 (+ lc2 1))))
                         (hash-set! result (list r c) bg-l))
                   (for* ((r (range r1 (+ r2 1))) (c (range rc1 (+ rc2 1))))
                         (hash-set! result (list r c) bg-r))
                   (for ((s shape-r))
                     (hash-set! result (list (+ r1 (first s)) (+ lc1 (second s))) bg-r))
                   (for ((s shape-l))
                     (hash-set! result (list (+ r1 (first s)) (+ rc1 (second s))) bg-l)))))
             (build-grid hh ww (r c) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))
